decisions.reason: The change from an existing NFT holder to an existing ticket holder is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source reiterates that the mint number is the referral code but does not change its basis, permanence, or display locations.
The source does not change any metadata visibility requirement; the mint-number referral code and ticket concepts remain unchanged.
The source repeats the $15 mint price and $5 referral commission but does not modify the revenue allocation.
The prize-payout question is independently represented by the candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event; the referral-recipient wording change does not alter the claim workflow.
The source continues to describe minting the same ebook NFT and does not change the minted asset or fulfillment behavior.
The source does not mention or change the optional confirmation email or its contents.
The source reiterates ticket weighting and Chainlink VRF selection without changing eligibility, weighting, randomness, or verification rules.
References to mint and secondary sales describe prize timing and do not change which sales fund the prize pools or the funding duration.
The source does not modify the required secondary-sale royalty, its amount, or its flat structure.
The generic mention of badges and gamification does not change any badge-award condition or referral threshold.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
